about.heading: Designing Digital Economies
paragraphs: Product leader with 8+ years of experience in Web3, GameFi, and digital ecosystems. I design and launch scalable token-based products with a strong focus on monetization, retention mechanics, and long-term economic sustainability.

At ECOS, I lead the architecture and development of Telegram Mini App GameFi products within the TON ecosystem — from product strategy and database design to game mechanics, marketplace and analytics.
My expertise lies at the intersection of product strategy, backend architecture, AI automation, and blockchain-based incentive systems.
